result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. The module compiles, but I didn't run any tests or add a new one.

The change is one added condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`. An unmatched contributor goes into the remainder only if `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` is true. That uses the existing 180-day threshold.

- **Blank dates:** `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` already returns true for a blank latest-commit date, so those contributors still count as active.
- **Configured teams:** that code path is untouched, so they keep all their members.
- **Remainder team:** it is still only added when it has members and repositories, so it disappears if every unmatched contributor is dormant.
